correctness.rationale: The modal validity equivalence R⊆R² is proven by a countervaluation at any unsupported arc. Exact mean EX=n(n−1)p(1−p²)^(n−2), yielding √(3/2)e^-t under the precise centering. Fixed factorial moments classify disjoint-endpoint r-tuples with independently absent external witnesses and show repeated-endpoint tuples negligible by O_r(n^{2r−1}) counting and Bonferroni factor exp(−rnp²+O_r(np³+p²)). Consequently X→Poisson and Pr(X=0) has the claimed limit. First moment controls high-density regime; trivial small edge count at p=n^-3 and O(1) supported arcs at p=n^-1 demonstrate reentrant validity. Independently enumerated all 4,64,4096 loop-free frames n=2,3,4; valid counts 1,2,88 and exact means 1,2.25,3.375.
residual_risks: No monotonicity across arbitrary p is asserted; full sharp phase diagram for all sparse regimes remains outside claim.
